note:
Reviewed CDB90 match 20, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: Preserve ENG PARL ARMY as a local military force rather than turning the broad Roundhead faction entry into a military unit. The existing Cavalier military participant matches ENG ROY ARMY.

The locally identified CDB90 English Parliamentary army uses a representative armoured pike component, following the National Army Museum’s surviving c.1640 pot helmet, cuirass, tassets and sidearm. Both parliamentary and royalist forces also fielded musketeers and other arms; this equipment assignment does not establish their proportions or an exact uniform. The local army identity, CDB90 personnel estimates and casualty categories remain unchanged.
